record.original_question: In two dimensions, consider elastic materials built from one elastic phase and void, and impose the limiting incompressible/auxetic condition kappa*=0 together with 1/kappa=0 for the solid phase. Is 4 mu / 5 the largest possible effective shear modulus mu* under these constraints?

evidence.quote: Problem 11: Is 4µ/5 the largest possible value of µ∗ for a two-dimensional elastic material with voids, given that κ∗ = 1/κ = 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider two-dimensional, two-phase composite materials in which one phase is an isotropic linearly elastic solid with bulk modulus $\kappa$ and shear modulus $\mu$, and the other phase is void (vanishing moduli). For any sufficiently regular periodic (or statistically homogeneous) microgeometry, classical homogenization assigns to the composite an isotropic effective bulk modulus $\kappa_*$ and an isotropic effective shear modulus $\mu_*$.

Restrict attention to microgeometries that simultaneously realize the two extreme constraints
$$\kappa_* = 0 \qquad\text{and}\qquad \frac{1}{\kappa} = 0,$$
that is, the composite is effectively incompressible-auxetic at the macroscopic level (zero effective bulk modulus) while the solid phase is taken in the rigid-bulk limit (infinite bulk modulus, finite shear modulus $\mu$).

Prove or disprove: under these constraints, the supremum of the effective shear modulus over all admissible isotropic microgeometries equals
$$\mu_*^{\max} = \frac{4\mu}{5}.$$

Equivalently, decide whether $\mu_* \le 4\mu/5$ holds for every such composite, with equality attainable (in a limiting sense) by some microstructure.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem in a list of open problems on composites (Milton, Phil. Trans. Roy. Soc. A, 2021). No subsequent published resolution of the bound $\mu_*\le 4\mu/5$ under the constraints $\kappa_*=0$ and $1/\kappa=0$ in two dimensions has been located in the literature, and related work on auxetic/void composites continues to discuss it as an open optimal-bound question.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems in the theory of composites
status_evidence.snippet: A list of open problems concerning bounds on effective tensors of composites, including questions on optimal shear modulus for two-dimensional materials with voids under auxetic constraints.
status_evidence.claim: The bound is listed as an unresolved open problem in a 2021 survey of open problems in the theory of composites.

status_evidence.title: The Theory of Composites — G. W. Milton
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of bounds on effective elastic moduli of two-phase composites with voids and of auxetic microstructures.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference discussing bounds on effective shear modulus of 2D composites with voids without resolving the 4µ/5 conjecture.
